subject: Only displaying selection of tip labels

messages.author: ed960445dd48c4c1
messages.subject: Only displaying selection of tip labels
parts:
Hi,

Apologies if this has been already discussed, but I can't find it in the history.
I have a tree that I am displaying along with some annotation in the form of a gheatmap.
I would like to display only a subset of the labels, but I can't seem to get it to work.


TREE.laz <- ladderize(Tree,FALSE)
      
      
# Plot tree
T <- ggtree(TREE.laz, branch.length="none")
       + geom_tiplab(aes(label=label, subset=isTip), color="blue", size =2)
            
H <- gheatmap(T, SampleMatrix, offset = 0, width=0.2, colnames = FALSE)
      

I have the list of the labels, RefIDs, that I want displayed. They are also the second column in my gheatmap. But I can't get to subset the display of the tip labels to only those. Any idea?

Thanks for your help!

Christophe
